statement: An actual smooth delta-invariant map Xc to the weighted Seifert S3 extends the finite translational quotient after modifying leaves inside the cusp; its outer gamma marking and zero transverse-meridian winding match explicitly, and the target regular-fibre push-off links the positive (3,4) knot twelve times.
depends_on: C.3.5;C.3.7-C.3.9;actual finite logarithmic overlaps;relative integral H1 extension
notes: The cusp replacement is constructed smoothly upstairs by an invariant integral closed1-form. It is not the literal rank-three quotient refuted in C.3.12, and the linking12 is not identified with the six-dimensional normal framing or a Theta7 residue.
